items.title: William Russell Interview, 1962-08-31
items.q: I have a record he made with Joe Dierensburg.

ctx.x: Yeah, no, Minor died. We got a good interview with him in 1958. Wow. He was playing very little then. He had left the Ori band in a disagreement.
I have a record he made with Joe Dierensburg. He might have played a little bit after that, not much.

So, because he, I heard. The LARP record? Yeah. It was made about that time, actually. He had cancer, I heard, at that time. He looked in pretty good health and talked like he'd be playing, like he was alright. But a couple years later, maybe about two years ago, he died. So, evidently he did have cancer. And he was one of the better drummers, not flashy in any way either. And maybe in some sense, monotonous compared to some of the other New Orleans drummers, but still a wonderful rhythm section. Buster Wilson…
